page.title: Contact notes & activity history
page.description: Maintain total clarity over your client relationships. Learn how to leverage the automated history timeline within your Smart CRM to track every interaction, and discover how to deploy private contact notes to ensure your team never misses a crucial negotiation detail.
page.body:
Contact Notes & Activity History: Tracking the Client Journey


In high-level real estate transactions, relying on memory or scattered email threads is a critical liability. To maintain a frictionless deal flow, your agency requires total clarity on every client interaction.

The PropertyList Smart CRM is engineered to solve this by providing a comprehensive, automated History Timeline for Contacts and Properties. By centralising your contact notes and activity history directly within your digital headquarters, you ensure that every team member has immediate access to the entire lifecycle of a lead.

The Automated Activity History Timeline

Every time you add an unlimited contact to your database, the infrastructure automatically generates a dedicated activity history timeline for that specific individual.
This timeline acts as an automated digital ledger. You do not need to manually log every single action; the system works for you by automatically tracking and recording key milestones, including:
  • Initial Capture: When the lead was generated and how they were automatically categorised (e.g., as a buyer or renter).
  • Linked Assets: The exact dates when specific MLS properties or transaction documents were linked to their profile.
  • Automated Alerts: When their tailored property alerts were triggered and which mandates were sent to them.
  • Status Changes: Any movements the contact makes through your active sales pipeline.

Deploying Private Contact Notes

While the system automates your major tracking milestones, nuanced human interactions require custom documentation. Within each contact's profile, agents can manually deploy Private Contact Notes.
These secure notes are essential for logging critical context that an algorithm cannot capture:
  • Viewing Feedback: Instantly log a client's honest reaction immediately after a property viewing.
  • Negotiation Parameters: Record specific financial boundaries, strict requirements, or non-negotiable amenities.
  • Personal Details: Note strategic relationship-building details, such as a client's preferred communication times or specific family needs.

The Strategic Advantage for Team Collaboration

If you operate a multi-agent agency, mastering contact notes and the activity history is your ultimate collaborative advantage.
When a contact is assigned to a specific staff member, that agent takes ownership of the lead. However, if that agent is unavailable, any authorised team member can instantly open the client's profile, read the most recent private notes, and review the automated activity history timeline. This guarantees that your agency provides a seamless, professional experience to the client, regardless of who answers the phone.

By combining automated activity tracking with detailed private notes, you transform your Smart CRM into a highly efficient engine for closing deals.
